logline: 바그다드의 뱃사람이 재물을 좇아 바다로 나가고, 딛고 선 섬이 움직이기 시작한다.
destination: 지도에 없는 섬 — 딛는 순간 움직이기 시작하는 땅
protagonist: 붉은 허리띠를 두른 서른 살의 바그다드 뱃사람
anchor: a sturdy Arab sailor of thirty with a short black beard, striped robe and red sash
palette: sea turquoise, sail white, desert ochre, brass gold, deep indigo shadow

sinbad.label: 뱃사람
sinbad.desc: a sturdy Arab sailor of thirty, short black beard, striped robe, red sash, bare feet

crew.label: 선원들
crew.desc: Arab sailors in loose tunics and head cloths, sun-darkened faces, ropes in hand

harbour.label: 바그다드 항구
harbour.desc: a crowded Arabian quay, wooden dhows, stacked bales and jars, striped awnings

island.label: 섬
island.desc: a low bare island of dark ridged ground, open sea all around

beats.visual: a bearded sailor loading bales onto a wooden dhow at a crowded Arabian quay
beats.motion: a bale swings up onto the deck, ropes strain, awnings flap along the quay

beats.visual: a wooden dhow under full sail on open turquoise sea, sailors at the ropes
beats.motion: the dhow drives forward across the swell, the sail bellies out, spray bursts

beats.visual: sailors stepping onto a low bare island of dark ridged ground, their dhow anchored beyond
beats.motion: they walk forward onto the ridged ground, water sheets off it, gulls scatter

beats.visual: sailors crouched around a small cook fire on dark ridged ground, sea all around
beats.motion: the fire catches and smoke lifts, the ground shudders, the men look down

beats.visual: a low dark island tilting under a scattered cook fire, water rushing up over the ridges
beats.motion: the ground heaves upward, water pours across it, the fire scatters and hisses

beats.visual: a bearded sailor clinging to a wooden cask in open sea, his dhow small and far off
beats.motion: the swell lifts him and the cask, the distant sail shrinks, foam slides past

beats.visual: a soaked sailor washed up on a pale unknown beach, palms and cliffs behind him
beats.motion: surf pushes him up the sand, water runs off his robe, palm tops toss

beats.beat: 빈 바다에 나무통 하나가 떠 있다.
beats.visual: an empty wooden cask drifting on wide calm sea at dusk, no land in sight
beats.motion: the cask rocks on the swell, light fades on the water, ripples spread

withheld: 그 섬의 정체와, 뱃사람이 마지막 항해에서 얻게 되는 것
